note: Set in sprint 0 (F5). The first load is the scripts, preloads and stylesheets that index.html asks for. Baseline on 2026-10-14 (React and the empty shell): 68.6 KB JS and 1.3 KB CSS, gzipped. Rich text, storage and undo will add to this. Presenting, export and anything else not needed to start editing must load lazily to stay inside the budget. Raising a number needs Peter's OK and a line in docs/decisions.md. The text editor (TipTap) is a lazy chunk with its own budget; it is fetched when text is first edited (sprint 3). The show windows (ShowApp) are a lazy chunk too, fetched when a show opens (sprint 7). The deck file code with its zip library (deckFileService) is another, fetched when a file is saved or opened (sprint 9).

show.note: PM-3 (sprint 8): a change made in one show window is drawn in the other within this many milliseconds (the 90th percentile of twenty key presses on the same clock). Chromium and Firefox are held to it; WebKit is measured and reported. SP-1 measured about 17 ms.

perf.note: UX-3 (sprint 5), written after spike SP-4 (the heavy-slide transition shares, sprint 7, are provisional: TN-5 asks for a budget of their own for slides of 50 elements, and the first nightly runs set it): on the nightly runner (no graphics card) Chromium and Firefox are held to these; WebKit is only reported. 60 fps itself is confirmed by hand on a real laptop and a Mac before each milestone. A frame is late when it took more than 25 ms. Raising a number needs Peter's OK and a line in docs/decisions.md.
